description: Taux de perte sur le réseau de distribution d'eau potable en 2018 (service WFS) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.karugeo.fr. Service WFS. In 2018, 78.3 Mm3 of drinking water was distributed throughout Guadeloupe. Of this total volume, only 39 % of the water (30.5 Mm3) was consumed by the population. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Loss rate on the drinking water distribution system in 2018 (WFS service)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include service public, réseaux, eau potable, pertes, fuites. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
